shape.situation_pattern: An imageboard post maps naturally onto a verkle knot graph.
shape.decision: Treat the board graph as topology and the post as a scalar; but don't compile every post onto the verkle chain.
shape.reasoning_physics: Play-face knots live on the room ledger and only promote to the durable chain when a FILE says so. A post that doesn't >> is an isolated vertex, a mill dump isn't a knot.
